checks.describe: core-internals profile is up and the worker node exists
inference-sim Deployment has 2 Running replicas in m9-lab namespace
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get deploy inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.status.readyReplicas}'

checks.describe: inference-sim Service exists in m9-lab namespace targeting port 8080
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get svc inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].targetPort}'

checks.describe: inference simulator responds to OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get pod -l app=inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"check","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}'

checks.describe: inference simulator exposes Prometheus metrics at /metrics (requests_total, kv_cache_utilization)
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get pod -l app=inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab exec $POD -- curl -s http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep -c 'requests_total\|kv_cache_utilization'

checks.describe: inference simulator streams tokens via Server-Sent Events when stream=true
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab get pod -l app=inference-sim -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m9-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"check","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":3,"stream":true}' | head -1
